info.name: Valor Admin Portal Stage 3B Notifications - LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY
info.description: Local development only at http://localhost:8081. API verification, NOT browser/UI verification. Import the matching blank environment; enter private local SUPER_ADMIN credentials; run the entire collection sequentially with one iteration. Step 04 visits both paginated directories and selects one eligible existing recipient; inbox reads page through all matching pages. Requires an existing active customer or technician. Creates and retains two uniquely labeled IN_APP notifications; marks only the current admin notification read. No deletion, fake sent-history, bulk or external delivery. Final recipient assertions use the create response: this does NOT verify the other recipient login/inbox or their later record state. Any required assertion stops the run; fix prerequisites and restart at 01, never continue manually. Repeated runs retain separate audit records. Do not export populated environments, save response examples or share captures containing credentials/tokens. Scripts do not log secrets.
